contract.cache_failure_classification: Only the exact three-marker models-cache schema signature authorizes recovery; generic JSON, CLI, auth, timeout, or path failures do not.
contract.cache_path_authority: Only <exact configured CODEX_HOME>/models_cache.json is eligible. Relative, divergent, symlinked, non-directory, unavailable, or unowned homes and symlinked/non-regular/unowned/multiply-linked caches fail closed.
contract.quarantine_atomicity: The cache is hashed through O_NOFOLLOW, identity is revalidated before os.replace, and the quarantined pathname is revalidated against the same inode evidence.
contract.probe_bound: Cache mutation is enabled only on the bounded pre-lock Codex recovery target. In-lock pre-dispatch probes never request quarantine. A quarantine failure consumes no refresh probe.
contract.quota_projection: Usage-limit output becomes quota_reached/quota_terminal, with quota_reset_at stored only after ISO/epoch normalization. It never becomes auth revocation.
contract.recovery: A fresh successful probe clears only the affected configured dispatch identity; failed, timeout, revoked, quota, cache, and ambiguous outcomes remain closed without launching a worker.
contract.routing: Configured account/quota identities remain authoritative. The existing atomic pair planner preserves explicit Human/Ops review and identity-only owner/reviewer independence; Codex and Codex2 are not globally coalesced.
